title: Viral 'Cat in the Hat' trend linked to arrests and school lockdowns
why: [news (uncanny hyperreality / social-media belief)] Claim: AI-generated Cat in the Hat “sightings” (doorbell/driveway found footage) migrate from TikTok prank to U.S. school closures and arrests — Assumption High closed Aug 31; Florida teen charged over Paducah threats; Wexford Garda: “AI prompt,” Cat “not in your driveway.” Bodies and institutions move on a feed copy.
